The sitcom Frasier is a spin-off of which beloved Boston bar-set sitcom?
questions.explanation: Frasier, which premiered in 1993, is actually the third spin-off of Cheers, following The Tortellis and The Tortellis (1987) and other attempts. It went on to become one of the most acclaimed spin-offs in TV history, winning 37 Primetime Emmy Awards.

questions.question: Which beloved children's TV show featuring Big Bird and the Cookie Monster is broadcast by the nonprofit network PBS?
questions.explanation: Sesame Street has been a flagship program of PBS, the Public Broadcasting Service, since its debut in 1969. The show is produced by Sesame Workshop and is one of the longest-running children's television programs in history. Its iconic characters like Big Bird, Elmo, and Cookie Monster have made it a household name worldwide.

questions.question: On the TV ratings and review site IMDb, which episode of the TNT police procedural *Major Crimes* holds one of the highest viewer ratings in the series, with a title referencing a covert intelligence exchange?
questions.explanation: "Dead Drop" is one of the top-rated episodes of *Major Crimes*, the TNT spin-off of *The Closer* that aired from 2012 to 2018. The title refers to a spy tradecraft method of passing items between agents without direct contact, which ties into the episode's gripping storyline. Its strong viewer ratings on platforms like IMDb reflect its popularity among fans of the series.

questions.question: Which two co-creators and stars chose to deliberately end their Hulu coming-of-age comedy series PEN15 rather than continue it indefinitely?
questions.explanation: Maya Erskine and Anna Konkle made the conscious decision to end PEN15 on their own terms, rather than letting the show run until cancellation. The semi-autobiographical series, in which they played middle-school versions of themselves as adults, aired on Hulu from 2019 to 2021. Their choice to conclude the story deliberately was a notable creative decision in an era when streaming shows often get cancelled unexpectedly.
